note: Task #150 + #77 — per-CHAMPION render-size overrides. As of #150 ChampionView HEIGHT-NORMALIZES every loaded champion glb to a common target height (render/views/ChampionView.ts TARGET_HEIGHT ≈ 1.8u) instead of applying each model doc's raw `scale` as an absolute — so by DEFAULT every champion reads the same on-screen size regardless of its glb's wildly-varying native mesh height. `relativeScale` is the per-champion RELATIVE multiplier on top of that normalization (1.0 = the normalized target height; <1 = deliberately smaller, >1 = bigger). Absent champions default to 1.0 (normal human = 夏娜). Keyed by championId. The optional `glbPath`/`clipMap` still swap in a genuinely different model. Files under content/models beginning with _ are NOT model@1 docs (like _index.json) and are skipped by the content validators/index builder. The composition root (GameApp.modelOverrideFor) loads this map via ContentDb and feeds EntityViewRegistry.modelOverrideFor -> applyModelOverride; `relativeScale` threads to ChampionView.tryUpgradeToGlb. Legacy note: pre-#150 this field was `scale` (an ABSOLUTE render scale); it is now `relativeScale`. See docs/_model-size-audit-150.md.
note77: TASK #77 — THE MAP'S DECLARED SCALE NOW SURVIVES THE STAND-IN FALLBACK. 40 godie-* champions have no shipped model of their own and render on one of the four shared CC0 KayKit meshes (champ.sela / champ.thorne / champ.skin.barbarian / champ.skin.rogue). Before this pass their w3x Scaling Value ('usca', tools/w3x-import/out/GoDieEX22s-src/OBJECTS.json) was DISCARDED on every one of them, so all 40 rendered at the identical normalized 1.8u — 小叮噹 (a ~1.3m robot cat) exactly as tall as 巴恩大魔王. RULE APPLIED HERE: relativeScale = the map's usca, verbatim. 23 of the 40 declare no usca at all (WC3 default 1.0) and therefore need no entry — an absent entry IS the map's value. 17 declare a non-default usca and are listed below. The rule is validated by the two size exceptions #150 had already hand-tuned from lore alone: 小叮噹 shipped 0.65 vs map 0.60, 初號機 shipped 1.55 vs map 1.60 — both agree to within 8%. Only the map's SCALE can be honoured today; the map's MODEL is a Blizzard MPQ asset that is not in the deployable tree (see blizzardOverlay.ts for the dev/family overlay path, and tasks #81/#116 for the shippable-replacement proposal). NOT capped: the map is the spec (a 2.0 usca is an authored giant, not a bug) — if one frames badly in the arena camera, tune that one number here. NOT applied: godie-u011, whose w3x usca 1.5 scales `collision.mdl`, a geometry-less dummy with no body to scale.
note31: GH#31 —— 替身英雄改載暴雪原始模型之後,#77 的『relativeScale = usca 逐字照抄』就不再成立了。#77 那條規則的前提是:這 40 位共用一顆 KayKit 替身網格,而那顆網格被正規化成 1.8u 之後『整個輪廓就是身體』,所以 usca 直接當倍率是對的。現在他們各自載入自己的 Warcraft III 模型,ChampionView 仍然把『整個輪廓』正規化到 1.8u —— 於是一個在 WC3 裡本來就比聖騎士高一截的模型,被硬壓成跟人類一樣高,usca 再乘上去也救不回來。正確算法(記在 godie-h021 的註解裡,#77 已經為那一位手算過):relativeScale = (該模型 rawHeight ÷ HeroPaladin 參考高度 115.63) × usca。數學上這是唯一會讓『身體』落在 WC3 比例上的式子:渲染身高 = 1.8 × rel × bodyGlb/nativeGlb,而 rel 帶進去之後 nativeGlb 會整項消掉,剩下 1.8 × usca × bodyRaw/115.63 —— 也就是說,即使某個模型的包圍盒被翅膀/殘留特效面片撐大,身體仍然落在正確尺寸。rawHeight 取自實際 glb 的量測值 ÷ 匯出器的 scaleFactor(= ChampionView 真正拿去除的那個數,換算回 mdx 單位),而不是 batches 裡回報的 rawHeight —— 兩者在 40 位裡有 38 位一致到 2% 以內,只有 godie-e015(-17%)與 godie-hpal(-12%)不同,那兩位若照回報值會渲染得偏小。本次只補『原本沒有條目』的 22 位;#77/#150 既有的 18 位維持不動(見 openQuestions:他們是對著共用替身網格手調的,對現在的模型已經偏小,需要 owner 拍板)。
